original N_i, clock length, weights and source ancestry
C-order array fingerprints proving A06/A10 ancestry
completed A14 V/I, fixed population, zero future/labels
inherit sealed numerical/physical evidence; no diagnostic subtree decode
inherit sealed numerical/physical evidence; no diagnostic subtree decode
inherit sealed numerical/physical evidence; no diagnostic subtree decode
inherit sealed numerical/physical evidence; no diagnostic subtree decode
six fixed physical-parameter descriptors; original A06 identity
six fixed physical-parameter descriptors; original A06 identity
six fixed physical-parameter descriptors; original A06 identity

source_access_order: dedicated metadata-only authorization and clean-HEAD guard
one bounded bytes read/hash/parse per listed source metadata file, with cached reuse
read_prerequisite: per-file durable reserve, first NPZ hash, then each allowed header/array once for A14 inputs/static/resets and old E control futures
validate all parameter/input/reset identities, E first-row matches and E step-refinement; durably save reset_freeze and seal_resets
only then read the A10 real_train_arrays NPZ whitelisted truth/clock/offset/omega_s members once and validate alignment
fixed I future paths, physical checks, metrics and four-class rule diagnostics
second full integrity pass over every listed NPZ without payload decoding

source_journal.reserve: durable whole-file hard quota before source access
source_journal.per_call: attempted before and returned/failed after, flush; journal failure stops globally
source_journal.close: exact identities and range SHA followed by durable close

forbidden: unlisted NPZ members or metadata paths
independent_audit_requirement: Saved-array replay of V/I/D and exact identities/read/operator ledgers, zero new source payload/model/RHS.
registration_control_files_note: This design/inventory/plan and later policy/protocol/implementation bindings are registration controls, not source payload. Their pre-run metadata-only checks are separately bound; the plan cannot self-hash. No later control may add an unlisted source read.
metadata_field_scope_note: allowed_json_paths is a list of key-component lists describing consumed fields. Each listed JSON is read/hashed/parsed once as bounded metadata and cached. The manifest '*:sha256_string' entry means its flat name-to-SHA mapping; unconsumed metadata never becomes a feature. No extra filesystem reads are implied by any path or source reference stored inside a JSON.

changes: place old control futures in prerequisite phase and truth future last
state exact already-frozen I/V/D clauses in machine-readable form

frozen_gate_definitions.comparison_units: all 3 seeds by both max_steps separately; no median/majority/selected seed

V_paths.fixed_window: same real-truth representative start/end in both paths and their margins

frozen_gate_definitions.D_M: count(T is True and P is not True)
frozen_gate_definitions.D_F: count(T is False and P is True)
frozen_gate_definitions.D_pass: all six groups have M_I<=M_E and F_I<=F_E, with complete bool trigger results
frozen_gate_definitions.D_unknown: None/missing is incomplete, never False; rho=0 is False with arithmetic_boundary retained
frozen_gate_definitions.overall: ACCEPT iff V and I and D; otherwise REJECT

limitations: A10 validators do not check hidden-state refinement; A15 checks it separately for E and I
first pointwise violations must be computed separately from strict original row_margin>0, full and future domains
keep all four numeric margin bounds, not flat qualified flags
